caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The chair has a dark brown or black frame with several rounded decorative knobs or joints colored in a muted yellow or gold. The backrest consists of two horizontal slats, with the topmost slat being slightly curved. The seat appears to be made of interwoven material in a yellowish-brown color, contrasting with the darker frame. The legs of the chair are turned, giving them a rounded, decorative appearance, and there are horizontal stretcher bars connecting the legs near the bottom, also adorned with decorative yellow or gold knobs. The composition is simple with the chair rendered in a realistic manner and there are no other objects or markings visible in the background.
title: Hitchcock Chair
